_readme: Single source for every Amazon product on the site. _tools/build.py renders
the cards on the home shop grid, the essentials page and the gift section
from this file, in EN/DE/SQ. Edit here, then run: python3 _tools/build.py
A product whose asin is null keeps its old 'short_link' until the correct
ASIN is confirmed (status NEEDS CHECK). Never guess an ASIN.
No prices for Amazon items: the button says 'Check price on Amazon'.
gift_budget is a label (up-to-15 / 15-30 / 30-60 EUR), never a price.

desc.en: Enameled interior, stainless steel infuser, stovetop safe. The forest green finish looks lovely next to dried herbs.
